candidates.cp_b_title_en: Real-time and Batch Screening: Types and Purposes

cp_a.title_zh: 政治敏感人物筛查方案考虑要点
cp_a.reason: Group of rules covering key areas: timing, parties, alert processing, testing, and additional controls.

units.zh: 政治敏感人物筛查须在客户激活前完成，并持续重新筛查
units.en: When to screen: In most jurisdictions, PEP screening must be done before the customer becomes active, and customers should be rescreened on an ongoing basis to check whether their PEP status has changed.

units.zh: 筛查对象包括公司客户的多名受益所有人及相关方
units.en: Who to screen: Consider which parties to screen, particularly if customers are corporate entities with multiple beneficial owners and associated parties.

units.zh: 须建立清晰的政治敏感人物警报处理流程和团队，高风险政治敏感人物需签批
units.en: Alert processing: Have a clear procedure and a team in place to clear the PEP alerts. Consider the tolerance for false positives during this process. There should also be a sign-off process for higher-risk PEPs.

units.zh: 须实施正式的持续测试流程，确保系统有效运行并包含质量检查
units.en: Testing: Implement a formal, ongoing testing process to ensure the system continues to operate effectively and with QA checks.

units.zh: 对政治敏感人物须在准入及整个客户生命周期中实施强化尽职调查等控制
units.en: Other controls: Include enhanced due diligence processes on PEPs at onboarding and throughout the customer life cycle. Consider what other controls are needed for PEPs, such as specific transaction monitoring rules.

units.zh: 无论内部或外包进行政治敏感人物筛查，均需考虑以下方面
units.en: Regardless of whether PEP screening is done in-house or via a vendor, the following areas should be considered:

cp_b.title_zh: 实时与批量筛查：类型与目的
cp_b.title_en: Real-time and Batch Screening: Types and Purposes
cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 持续筛查分为实时筛查和批量筛查两种类型，各有其用途
units.en: There are typically two types of screening: Real-time screening and batch screening. Each serves its own purpose.

units.zh: 实时筛查在支付发生时进行，有助于防止涉及受制裁个人或实体的交易
units.en: Real-time screening involves screening payments as they happen, which helps prevent payments involving sanctioned individuals or entities.

units.zh: 批量筛查是对机构整个客户群进行制裁和恐怖名单筛查的过程
units.en: Batch screening is a process of screening the organization’s entire customer base against sanctions and terror lists.

units.zh: 支付系统中的持续筛查对于预防和检测洗钱、恐怖融资和制裁规避至关重要
units.en: Ongoing screening in payment systems is critical for preventing and detecting financial crimes, including money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions evasion.

units.zh: 未能阻止受制裁交易会使企业面临严重的监管处罚、声誉损害和法律后果
units.en: Failing to prevent such transactions can put any business at risk for severe regulatory penalties, reputational damage, and legal consequences.

units.zh: 违反制裁法规可能导致美国OFAC或英国OFSI等监管机构处以巨额罚款
units.en: Noncompliance with sanctions regulations can result in heavy fines imposed by regulatory bodies such as the OFAC in the US or OFSI in the UK.

units.zh: 机构在客户准入时作为了解你的客户检查的一部分，应实时筛查客户是否涉及制裁或恐怖名单
units.en: When an organization onboards a customer, as part of its KYC checks it should screen the customer in real time against sanctions or terror lists.

units.zh: 若客户被识别为政治敏感人物，机构可能需要进行额外的尽职调查
units.en: If the customer is identified as a PEP, the organization may need to conduct additional due diligence.

units.zh: 机构还会针对特定观察名单和政治敏感人物名单进行筛查
units.en: Organizations also screen customers against specific watch lists and PEP lists.

units.zh: 对现有客户进行批量筛查是必要的，因为客户可能在准入后被列入制裁或观察名单
units.en: Batch screening of existing customers is necessary because a customer may have been added to a sanctions or watch list since being onboarded. The only way an organization can know about the customer’s change in status is by batch screening.

units.zh: 实时筛查用于立即拦截支付，批量筛查用于识别已列入制裁或观察名单的现有客户
units.en: Organizations use both real-time and batch screening because they serve different purposes. Real-time screening is necessary for payments that organizations must detect and block immediately. Batch screening identifies existing customers who have been added to sanctions or watch lists.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Rules-based monitoring: continued relevance and supplementation

cp_a.title_zh: 基于规则的监控：持续的相关性与补充
cp_a.title_en: Rules-based monitoring: continued relevance and supplementation
cp_a.reason: Captures the concluding statement that despite being static, rules-based monitoring remains foundational and is often supplemented.

units.zh: 基于规则的监控虽静态且需手动更新，但仍是反洗钱合规的基础工具。
units.en: Although rules-based monitoring is static and does not adapt unless manually updated, it remains a foundational tool for AML compliance.

units.zh: 许多组织辅以基于风险的监控或AI增强，以提高检测可疑活动的准确性和效率。
units.en: Many organizations supplement it with risk-based monitoring or AI-driven enhancements to improve accuracy and efficiency in detecting suspicious activities.

cp_b.reason: Merges the definition of TM systems and the module overview into one introductory review point.

units.zh: 交易监控系统是帮助金融机构检测可疑交易模式的技术框架
units.en: Transaction monitoring (TM) systems are the technological frameworks that help financial institutions detect suspicious transaction patterns.

units.zh: 本模块介绍交易监控系统的最佳实践、警报评估、调查类型及系统调优
units.en: In this module, we will explore industry best practices and expectations for TM systems. You will gain skills to evaluate transaction monitoring alerts and understand the various types of investigations that might follow. This module will also cover best practices in data analysis and documentation, equipping you to conduct thorough AML investigations, and understand system tuning.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Definition and Characteristics of Offshore Financial Centers
candidates.cp_b_title_en: Securities and Brokerage Money Laundering Risks and Controls

cp_a.title_zh: 离岸金融中心的定义与特征
cp_a.title_en: Definition and Characteristics of Offshore Financial Centers
cp_a.reason: Groups the definition and supporting descriptive characteristics of OFCs into one review point.

units.zh: 离岸金融中心为非居民提供复杂金融服务
units.en: An offshore financial center (OFC) is a jurisdiction that provides sophisticated financial services to non-residents. OFCs are also known as offshore booking centers.

units.zh: 离岸金融中心作为非居民稳定便捷的金融服务中心
units.en: They serve as a stable and convenient financial services hub for nonresidents.

units.zh: 离岸金融中心支持跨境交易与资金管理
units.en: OFCs allow businesses to conduct cross-border transactions and manage funds.

units.zh: 离岸金融中心客户受益于有利的监管环境与地理邻近性
units.en: Customers who use OFCs benefit from favorable regulatory environments due to their geographical proximity to key markets.

cp_b.title_zh: 证券和经纪洗钱风险与控制措施
cp_b.title_en: Securities and Brokerage Money Laundering Risks and Controls
cp_b.reason: This core point covers the sector's specific money laundering vulnerabilities and the recommended controls, forming a coherent review chunk on securities and brokerage risks.

units.zh: 证券业在洗钱的离析阶段和融合阶段尤其脆弱。
units.en: This sector is particularly vulnerable during the layering and integration stages of money laundering.

units.zh: FATF指出证券业既可洗钱也可通过欺诈产生非法资金。
units.en: FATF notes that the sector is unique in that it can be used not only to launder illicit funds but also to generate illicit funds within the industry itself through fraudulent activities.

units.zh: 持续监控交易活动以识别异常模式，防范洗钱
units.en: Continuous monitoring of trading activities can help identify unusual patterns or behaviors that might indicate money laundering. Robust transaction monitoring systems that flag suspicious transactions based on predefined criteria can help identify large or unusual trades, rapid trading patterns, highfrequency transactions and transactions involving high-risk jurisdictions.

units.zh: FATF指出证券服务商范围从零售投资者到机构市场。
units.en: According to FATF, securities providers can range from those that largely interact with retail investors, such as retail stockbrokers, wealth managers, and financial advisors, to those who serve institutional markets such as clearing members, prime brokers, and global custodians.

units.zh: 服务商提供资本市场研究、投资组合管理和投资基金分销等服务。
units.en: Providers offer various services including capital market research, portfolio management, and investment funds distribution.

units.zh: 证券和经纪业服务于直接客户和代表其客户交易的中介。
units.en: The securities and brokerage sector serves direct customers and intermediaries that transact on behalf of their underlying customers.

units.zh: 交易涵盖多种金融工具，包括可转让证券、货币市场工具、投资基金、期权、期货等。
units.en: Transactions can encompass a wide range of financial instruments, including transferable securities, moneymarket instruments, investment funds, options, futures, swaps, forward rate agreements, and other derivative contracts.

units.zh: 高互动性、大交易量、快速执行和匿名性为洗钱创造机会。
units.en: Characteristics such as high levels of interaction between securities providers and intermediaries such as investors and brokers, substantial transaction volumes, rapid execution speeds, and a degree of anonymity, all create opportunities for criminals to launder proceeds.

units.zh: 复杂金融产品可能掩盖资金来源并复杂化交易监控。
units.en: Complex financial products present a risk as they can obscure the source of funds and complicate transaction monitoring.

units.zh: 离岸账户提供匿名性，便利洗钱并利用监管宽松的司法管辖区。
units.en: Offshore accounts provide anonymity, which can facilitate money laundering and enable criminals to exploit lax regulatory jurisdictions.

units.zh: 高风险客户如政治敏感人物和中介机构需要仔细的风险评估
units.en: High-risk customers, such as PEPs, and intermediaries require careful risk assessment. PEPs might be susceptible to corruption, while intermediaries might facilitate illicit transactions on behalf of customers.

units.zh: 电子交易平台的高速度和高交易量增加了监控难度
units.en: Additionally, the rise of electronic trading platforms emphasizes speed and high transaction volumes, making it challenging to monitor and apply mitigation controls.

units.zh: 客户尽职调查用于验证资金来源和客户细分
units.en: Conducting CDD helps ensure that the source of funds is legitimate, and that customers are correctly segmented according to their expected and historical trading patterns.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Cryptoassets: Types, Technology, and Transaction Flow

cp_a.title_zh: 加密资产：类型、技术与交易流程
cp_a.title_en: Cryptoassets: Types, Technology, and Transaction Flow
cp_a.reason: Human review accepted this non-contiguous grouping because it forms one useful review topic in the section.

units.zh: 加密资产包括虚拟货币（如比特币）和稳定币（如USDT、USDC）。
units.en: Cryptoassets encompass virtual currencies, such as Bitcoin, and stablecoins, such as Tether (USDT) and USD Coin (USDC).

units.zh: 稳定币通过锚定传统资产（如法币）来最小化价格波动。
units.en: Stablecoins are designed to minimize price volatility by pegging their value to traditional assets, such as fiat currencies.

units.zh: 加密资产通常需要VASP等第三方提供商协助兑换法币。
units.en: Cryptoassets usually require third-party providers, known as VASPs, to assist in exchanging for fiat currency.

units.zh: 加密资产在公共账本（如区块链）上运行，使用密码学保护交易数据。
units.en: These assets operate on public ledgers, such as blockchains, which use cryptography to secure transaction data. Cryptography secures cryptoasset data via a distributed ledger, which publicly stores the data of the cryptoassets.

units.zh: 账本网络的去中心化消除了单一中心账本，实现快速点对点交易。
units.en: The decentralized nature of these ledger networks eliminates the need for one centralized ledger, allowing for fast, peer-to-peer transactions.

units.zh: 无许可监督可实现快速便捷支付，并为无银行账户者提供支付方式。
units.en: Permissionless oversight allows for fast, easy payments and provides a payment method to individuals without access to mainstream financial services.

units.zh: 比特币和以太坊等加密资产价格波动大，更适合投资和投机。
units.en: In contrast, cryptoassets, such as Bitcoin and Ethereum, experience significant price fluctuations, making them more suitable for investment and speculative purposes rather than as stable mediums of exchange.

cp_b.title_zh: 结构化、微结构化和化整为零
cp_b.reason: Describes a core technique where large funds are split into small transactions to evade AML thresholds, including variations like microstructuring for digital assets

units.zh: 洗钱技术：结构化/微结构化/化整为零
units.en: Structuring, microstructuring, smurfing:

units.zh: 将大额非法资金拆分为小额交易以规避反洗钱报告门槛
units.en: Large illicit funds are split into small transactions to avoid triggering AML reporting thresholds.

units.zh: 犯罪分子利用多个账户、金融机构和中间人逃避监控
units.en: Criminals use multiple accounts, financial institutions, and intermediaries to evade monitoring.

units.zh: 微结构化类似传统结构化，但常用于数字资产洗钱
units.en: Microstructuring resembles traditional structuring but is typically used with digital asset laundering.

cp_a.title_zh: 离岸金融中心的定义与特征
cp_a.title_en: Definition and Characteristics of Offshore Financial Centers
cp_a.reason: Groups the definition and supporting descriptive characteristics of OFCs into one review point.

units.zh: 离岸金融中心为非居民提供复杂金融服务
units.en: An offshore financial center (OFC) is a jurisdiction that provides sophisticated financial services to non-residents. OFCs are also known as offshore booking centers.

units.zh: 离岸金融中心作为非居民稳定便捷的金融服务中心
units.en: They serve as a stable and convenient financial services hub for nonresidents.

units.zh: 离岸金融中心支持跨境交易与资金管理
units.en: OFCs allow businesses to conduct cross-border transactions and manage funds.

units.zh: 离岸金融中心客户受益于有利的监管环境与地理邻近性
units.en: Customers who use OFCs benefit from favorable regulatory environments due to their geographical proximity to key markets.

cp_b.title_zh: 托管服务的洗钱与金融犯罪风险
cp_b.title_en: Money Laundering and Financial Crime Risks in Custodial Services
cp_b.reason: All units describe various inherent risks and mechanisms; they form a single review topic on custodial risk exposure.

units.zh: 托管服务固有洗钱风险，尤其涉及壳公司或名义账户。
units.en: Money laundering risks are inherent in custodial services, particularly with shell companies or nominee accounts.

units.zh: 依赖其他银行进行了解你的客户检查会带来金融犯罪风险，可能无意中为非法资金提供便利。
units.en: Financial crime risks in custodial services stem from relying on other banks to perform KYC checks. This reliance creates a false sense of security, as the custodian bank might not have complete information on client identities. If the other bank fails to perform adequate checks, the custodian could inadvertently facilitate transactions involving illicit funds, exposing itself to regulatory scrutiny.

units.zh: 空壳公司或名义账户可隐藏资产真实所有权，难以识别受益所有人。
units.en: They can conceal true ownership of assets, making it difficult to identify beneficial owners.

units.zh: 托管银行可能被用于离析阶段交易，增加追踪资金起源和识别可疑活动的难度。
units.en: Additionally, custodian banks might be used to layer transactions, complicating the tracking of fund origins and identification of suspicious activity.

units.zh: 链条中的多个客户因复杂所有权结构而增加风险，模糊受益所有人并复杂化交易追踪。
units.en: Multiple customers in a chain present additional risks as complex ownership structures obscure beneficial ownership and complicate transaction tracing. Each additional client in the chain adds a layer of complexity, which can complicate due diligence processes.

units.zh: 原则要点包括符合高道德标准及当地法律法规。

units.zh: 原则要点包括在不违反客户保密的前提下与执法部门充分合作。
units.en: Full cooperation with national law enforcement to the extent permitted without breaching customer confidentiality.

units.zh: 原则要点包括员工培训。
units.en: Staff training.

units.zh: 原则要点包括记录保存和审计。
units.en: Recordkeeping and audits.

units.zh: 1988年BCBS发布《银行系统用于洗钱的犯罪用途》原则声明，聚焦六项要点。

cp_b.title_zh: 增加银行业洗钱风险的因素
cp_b.title_en: Factors increasing banking sector's vulnerability to money laundering
cp_b.reason: Units 422-425 each describe a specific factor; unit 421 introduces the list. Together they form a distinct review point on contributors to banking vulnerability.

units.zh: 银行每日处理大量交易，非法资金易混入合法活动
units.en: Volume and scale: Banks handle a large volume of transactions daily, making it easier for illicit funds to blend in with legitimate activities.

units.zh: 银行国际业务使犯罪分子能跨境转移资金并利用监管差异
units.en: Global reach: Many banks operate internationally, providing criminals with the ability to move funds across borders and exploit regulatory differences.

units.zh: 银行复杂产品（如电汇、贸易融资）可能被洗钱者利用
units.en: Complex products: The variety of financial products and services offered by banks, such as wire transfers, investments, trade finance, and correspondent banking, can be exploited by money launderers.

units.zh: 银行强调客户关系可能导致对高风险客户审查不足
units.en: Customer relationships: Banks often emphasize maintaining strong customer relationships, which can sometimes lead to insufficient scrutiny of high-risk customers.

units.zh: 银行业洗钱风险增高的多个因素
units.en: Several factors contribute to the banking sector's increased vulnerability to money laundering:

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Research and Due Diligence Steps for Charities and NGOs
candidates.cp_b_title_en: Vendor Due Diligence (KYV): Screening and Cybersecurity Checks

cp_a.title_zh: 慈善机构和非政府组织的研究与尽职调查步骤
cp_a.title_en: Research and Due Diligence Steps for Charities and NGOs
cp_a.reason: outlines key actions: verify registration, tax-exempt status, tax returns, and consult unbiased evaluations

units.zh: 研究慈善机构时应查询注册机构、免税状态和税务申报
units.en: While researching charities and NGOs, be sure to search the relevant registration authorities to confirm their exempt status and their annual tax return filings. Also, consult websites that provide unbiased evaluations of charities and NGOs. It is likely that larger organizations will have a list of approved websites to conduct this research.

cp_b.title_zh: 供应商尽职调查（KYV）：筛查与网络安全检查
cp_b.title_en: Vendor Due Diligence (KYV): Screening and Cybersecurity Checks
cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 了解你的供应商（KYV）计划用于评估第三方供应商风险
units.en: A know your vendor (KYV) program helps assess the risk of third-party vendors.

units.zh: 入职时对供应商及其代表进行尽职调查筛查
units.en: During onboarding, organizations conduct due diligence measures that typically include screening the organization and persons acting on its behalf.

units.zh: 建议筛查供应商员工姓名和出生日期以发现欺诈或利益冲突
units.en: To detect fraudulent activity or potential conflicts of interest, it is recommended that organizations screen vendor staff names and dates of birth.

units.zh: 对需访问IT基础设施的供应商进行网络安全检查以确认合规
units.en: If vendors provide IT services that require access to the organization's IT infrastructure, the organization should conduct a cybersecurity check to confirm compliance with its policies.

units.zh: 供应商可能提供有价物品影响员工行为，导致贿赂和腐败风险
units.en: Vendors might offer items of value to influence the actions of your employees, which leads to bribery and corruption risks.

units.zh: 欺诈可由员工或供应商实施
units.en: Fraud can be committed by employees or vendors.

units.zh: 供应商可能带来欺诈、数据隐私和安全风险
units.en: Vendors might introduce fraud, data privacy, and security risks if they enter a relationship with the organization with the intention to defraud or if the vendor has incapable systems.

units.zh: 示例：使用开源情报对董事进行制裁、政治敏感人物和负面媒体名单筛查
units.en: For example, directors should be screened against sanctions, PEPs, and adverse media lists using open-source intelligence, such as search engines.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Importance of data quality and its impact on compliance

cp_a.reason: Covers the geographic extension, the two-category scope classification, the respective rules, and the definition of data controllers/processors, all essential for understanding to whom GDPR applies.

units.zh: 《通用数据保护条例》通过欧盟与欧洲经济区的程序扩展适用于整个欧洲经济区
units.en: The EU extended the GDPR to apply to the entire EEA, which consists of the EU member states plus Norway, Iceland, and Liechtenstein, through procedures established between the EU and EEA.

units.zh: 《通用数据保护条例》适用范围：在欧盟/欧洲经济区设立，或向该区域数据主体提供商品/服务或监控其行为
units.en: To fall within the scope of the GDPR, an organization must fall into one of two categories: the organization is established in the EU and EEA, or offers goods or services to, or monitors the behavior of, data subjects in the EU and EEA.

units.zh: 在欧盟/欧洲经济区设立的组织，无论数据主体位于何处，均须适用《通用数据保护条例》
units.en: If the organization is established in the EU and EEA, it must apply GDPR rights and protections to the personal data of data subjects irrespective of their location.

units.zh: 非欧盟/欧洲经济区组织须对位于欧盟/欧洲经济区的数据主体适用《通用数据保护条例》
units.en: If the organization is not established in the EU or EEA, it is required to apply GDPR rights and protections to the personal data of data subjects located in the EU and EEA.

units.zh: 《通用数据保护条例》明确区分数据控制者和数据处理者，二者承担不同职责
units.en: The regulation clearly defines data collectors and data processors, who have different duties in handling personal data.

cp_b.title_zh: 数据质量的重要性及其对合规的影响
cp_b.title_en: Importance of data quality and its impact on compliance
cp_b.reason: These units collectively explain why data quality matters: it determines system effectiveness, raw data issues lead to missed risks, data should be fit for purpose, and professionals need good data for AFC monitoring and screening. Unit 4778 supports the risk indicator.

units.zh: 数据质量决定组织在合规系统和流程中使用数据元素的效果。
units.en: Data quality is a determinant of how well organizations can use data elements within compliance systems and processes.

units.zh: 不准确和不完整的数据可能导致遗漏犯罪风险。
units.en: Inaccurate and incomplete data can lead to missed instances of criminal risk.

units.zh: 高质量数据不必完美，但应适合其用途。
units.en: While high-quality data does not need to be perfect, it should be fit for its purpose.

units.zh: 金融犯罪防控合规需要高质量数据来监控和筛查客户
units.en: For AFC compliance, professionals need good data to monitor or screen customers in alignment with their risk appetite and determine where financial crime risk occurs to a satisfactory level of accuracy.

units.zh: 原始数据常包含错误、不一致和缺失信息。
units.en: Raw data often contains errors, inconsistencies, and missing information.

cp_a.title_zh: 安全技术：防火墙、杀毒软件与加密
cp_a.reason: Standalone review point defining security technology and listing key tools to safeguard IT infrastructure.

units.zh: 安全技术包括防火墙、杀毒软件和加密工具，保护IT基础设施。
units.en: Security technology includes tools such as firewalls, antivirus software, and encryption tools. These tools safeguard an organization’s IT infrastructure.

cp_b.reason: Describes PET as a solution to privacy challenges, including federated learning, secure multiparty computation, and data anonymization, enabling secure, compliant data analysis and sharing.

units.zh: 隐私增强技术（PET）包括联邦学习、安全多方计算和数据匿名化等。
units.en: To address these challenges, banks can adopt privacy-enhancing technologies (PET), such as federated learning, secure multiparty computation, or data anonymization.

units.zh: PET 能在保护隐私和合规的同时实现安全的数据分析与共享，确保 金融犯罪防控 有效性。
units.en: These technologies enable secure data analysis and information sharing while preserving privacy and regulatory compliance, ensuring that AFC efforts remain effective without compromising personal data protection.

cp_a.title_zh: 第三支柱：持续的员工培训
cp_a.reason: Describes the mandate for regular, ongoing AML training, justified by changing regulations and tactics, and specifying coverage of controls and roles.

units.zh: 第三大支柱要求对员工进行定期、持续的反洗钱培训。
units.en: The third pillar mandates regular, ongoing AML training for employees.

units.zh: 法规与犯罪手法及复杂程度频繁变化，因此培训必须持续更新。
units.en: Regulations and laws change frequently, and so do financial criminal tactics and sophistication.

units.zh: 培训应涵盖内部控制并清晰说明员工在反洗钱计划中的角色与职责。
units.en: Training should cover internal controls and clearly explain employees’ roles and responsibilities within the AML program.

cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 运营成功依赖于维护一支具备管理、故障排除和优化金融犯罪防控系统能力的熟练员工队伍
units.en: Operational success depends upon maintaining a skilled workforce capable of managing, troubleshooting, and optimizing the AFC system. This includes IT support specialists, cybersecurity experts, compliance officers, and data analysts to ensure system security, operational effectiveness, and regulatory adherence.

units.zh: 日常维护（如调优校准和系统增强）可能需要内部团队与外部支持相结合
units.en: A combination of in-house teams and external support may be necessary for routine maintenance, such as tuning and calibration, and system enhancements.
